applies_to: all durable contract metadata not assigned a narrower transform
transforms.input_class: typed owner record before storage admission
transforms.output_rule: Admit stable identities, hashes, bounded enums, counts, timestamps, and opaque non-secret refs only.
transforms.retention_effect: Rejected secret-bearing inputs produce no ordinary durable value; quarantine stores only a non-secret reason and source hash under the applicable quarantine policy.

transforms.input_class: Settings owner values and result metadata
transforms.output_rule: Persist only validated inventory setting IDs, typed values, Project identity, revisions, exact changed-ID sets, hashes, and non-secret owner refs.
transforms.retention_effect: Current Project snapshot replaces current state; result and export metadata follow the assigned bounded receipt policy.

transforms.input_class: Project and Named Plan aggregate records
transforms.output_rule: Admit stable IDs, lifecycle/revision fields, safe refs, bounded names, and migration disposition counts without filesystem bytes or credentials.
transforms.retention_effect: Canonical aggregate and migration authority retain under their assigned hold-aware policies.

transforms.input_class: Product Onboarding session and legacy migration input
transforms.output_rule: Preserve stable identities; the exact current nine-stage main-path or six-stage connect-existing state; independent local Safe History backend, optional online-forge, Server, Storage, and Client selections; queued and reviewed plan revisions; person-confirmed Review state; approved-plan hash; Automatic Preparation currentness; owner refs; decisions; generations; bounded warnings; receipt refs; and exact migration counts only. Seven-stage input is migration lineage and never current state.
transforms.retention_effect: Current session is replace-current; one-time domain migration receipt and the referenced Storage migration receipt retain independently under receipt authority.

transforms.input_class: Doctor descriptor, normalized owner finding, and migration reconciliation metadata
transforms.output_rule: Persist bounded normalized findings, descriptor/cache generation, freshness/currentness, redacted evidence and receipt refs, and explicit dropped/quarantined reasons.
transforms.retention_effect: Descriptor identity is authority; cache projections expire by descriptor TTL and generation, and migrated cache never becomes fresh evidence.

transforms.input_class: Server and Remote Access public records, connector configuration/identity refs, projections/health, requests, results, errors, availability, migrations, and receipts
transforms.output_rule: Admit stable Server/connector/route identity, generations, version/build/protocol facts, bounded state enums, capability/currentness, policy and secure-state refs, result/disabled reason codes, timestamps, and redacted fingerprints/origin/host refs only. A secure_state_ref or authorization_session_ref never authorizes dereference into ordinary storage.
prohibited_inputs: tailnet node key, auth key, pre-auth key, machine key, or private key
raw tsnet connector state, state database, profile, enrollment, or node identity
raw credential, token, authorization code, reusable authorization URL/query, callback payload, or session credential
IPC authentication secret or raw IPC payload
cookie, browser DOM/storage/network/console data, or protected browser content
unredacted Headscale credential or control URL query
private path, private host/address, or broad absolute path rather than an opaque redacted ref
secret-bearing route configuration or unsafe SCM configuration
screenshot, recording, clipboard/history, capture frame, or retained media
transforms.retention_effect: Trust and revocation authority honor holds; discovery/session/projection history remains bounded by assigned policies.

transforms.input_class: Backup/Restore v2 public catalog, repository, run, manifest, policy, schedule, migration, browse, RecoverySet-public, no-store delivery-session metadata, request, result, error, availability, receipt, and health records
transforms.output_rule: Admit hashes, counts, bounded enums, stable object/family/repository/RecoverySet identities, engine key-slot identifiers, protected attachment/channel refs, non-secret destination/auth-profile refs, currentness, redacted reason codes, verification results, custody/Kit-confirmation facts, and external-byte refs only. Opaque protected refs are never dereferenced, copied, logged, captured, or exported by this transform.
prohibited_inputs: raw Backup Recovery Key, Recovery Kit bytes, passphrase, key-slot secret, or decrypted repository content
protected scheduler attachment contents, protected submission contents, or RecoveryKit delivery-session payload
API key, password, PAT, OAuth token, refresh token, authorization code, auth URL/query, callback payload, cookie, or destination credential contents
AuthBrowserSession or ordinary browser DOM, storage, console, network, history, profile, screenshot, or download contents
private repository/path/host/address, foreign absolute path, raw source path, or source-host detail rather than an opaque redacted ref
raw tsnet identity, keys, connector state, enrollment, authorization handoff, or IPC secret
unsafe SCM configuration, credential helper configuration, hook, agent socket, environment value, or unredacted CLI output
live process or PTY state, reconstructable cache payload, clipboard history, print spool payload, screenshot, recording, capture frame, or retained media
transforms.retention_effect: BackupPolicy and BackupRetentionDecision govern generation eligibility; legal/recovery/in-flight holds override expiry and verification failure quarantines the candidate.

transforms.input_class: Source Control and Forge aggregate, provider-instance, repository/automation binding, public request/result/error/availability, receipt, lease-metadata, projection, and health/currentness values
transforms.output_rule: Admit immutable revision and provider-native object IDs, fenced lease metadata, opaque repository/account/provider/service/instance/automation refs, independent binding generations, capability/permission/currentness refs, signed-delivery digests, bounded health/result/error/disabled reason codes, and receipt facts. Private host/path/account details are masked or replaced by stable opaque refs.
prohibited_inputs: private key, SSH material, PAT, raw token, password, authorization code, OAuth grant, header, or cookie
credential contents duplicated behind credential_or_grant_ref, auth_profile_ref, private_ca_ref, or known-host proof ref
raw agent socket, credential helper exchange, askpass payload, or credential-bearing environment value

unsafe SCM configuration or contents including global/system config, include/includeIf, url rewrite, credential helper, core.hooksPath, hook, alias, smudge/clean/process filter, SSH command, proxy command, or arbitrary executable config
webhook signature or raw webhook body
unredacted CLI stdout/stderr or provider error payload
private repository path, absolute path, private host/address/origin, or local machine identity rather than an opaque redacted ref
screenshot, recording, capture frame, clipboard/history, or retained media
transforms.retention_effect: Authority, immutable revisions, receipts, and webhook dedupe facts honor holds; operation-scoped credential material never persists.

transforms.input_class: ordinary BrowserProgram, ProgramWorkspace, routine, result, routing, receipt, and projection records
transforms.output_rule: Require the ordinary-browser subject discriminator and persist only typed bounded workspace values, hashes, refs, generations, receipts, and redacted results.
transforms.retention_effect: Programs, workspace revisions, routines, results, and receipts use bounded history; protected-session inputs produce no ordinary storage output.

transforms.input_class: Test Capture metadata and retained raw or derived media before durable artifact admission
transforms.output_rule: Persist typed metadata plus media only after source or encoder masking; display-only masking never qualifies retained bytes as redacted.
transforms.retention_effect: Raw immutable evidence and derived demonstration media retain separate identities and policies; provenance and gaps survive pruning; corrupt segments quarantine.

transforms.input_class: portable and PM-native plugin manifests, package/proof, conformance, and lifecycle receipt records
transforms.output_rule: Admit manifest/package identities, hashes, signature metadata, permission/capability declarations, component results, rollback refs, and bounded lifecycle outcomes.
transforms.retention_effect: Package/proof/conformance authority is hold-eligible; lifecycle receipts follow bounded operational history.

transforms.input_class: governor decision, command outcome, ObservableWork, projection, continuity, and public-ingress decision values
transforms.output_rule: Admit identity envelopes, requested/effective budgets, lifecycle enums, bounded reasons, frame/currentness data, receipt refs, and redacted public-ingress facts.
transforms.retention_effect: Command/work/continuity lineages remain durable and bounded; projection generations compact without collapsing the three independent lifecycle axes.

transforms.input_class: protected human-only browser session or any derived content/state
transforms.output_rule: Produce no ordinary stored value, artifact, screenshot, representation, automation result, or reusable session identity; only the separately owned redacted denial/lifecycle projection may exist.
transforms.retention_effect: No protected-session content or state is retained, restored, copied, promoted, captured, exported, or backed up.
